title: ATB Event v1
description: Canonical ATB event object used for hash computation and verification.
$comment: NDJSON line-length cap: 16,777,216 bytes (16 MiB). Readers MAY reject lines exceeding this limit. See docs/spec-v1.0.md §2.3.

atb.bundle.manifest.description: Reserved system type. Must be the first record in a bundle and uses seq 0.
atb.bundle.manifest.$comment: The manifest data payload has two supported shapes selected by manifest version. v1 (the writer default for maximum compatibility) wraps the manifest fields as a JSON-encoded string in event.data — readers must json-decode data a second time. This double-encoding is historical, not a deliberate design choice; it is preserved so existing bundles re-verify byte-for-byte. v2 stores the manifest as a structured JSON object directly in event.data. Both forms hash with the same RFC 8785 canonicaliser as any other event; the difference is only in what data contains. See docs/spec-v1.0.md §3.1.

oneOf.description: v1 manifest: JSON-encoded string containing manifest fields (version, bundle_id, created_at). Must be JSON-decoded a second time.

atb.bundle.anchor.description: TSA anchor record. Written after a successful RFC 3161 timestamp request. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it anchors, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0. The data payload is written as a JSON string with these fields.

atb.bundle.signature.description: Bundle signature record. Written after signing the pre-sign bundle NDJSON bytes. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it signs, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0.

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the raw 32-byte bundle hash. Encoding depends on algorithm: raw 64 bytes for ed25519, ASN.1 DER (r,s) for ecdsa-p256.

pubkey.description: Base64-encoded public key. For ed25519, the raw 32-byte key. For ecdsa-p256, either a PKIX DER blob or a 65-byte uncompressed point (0x04 || X || Y).

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm. Absent or empty implies ed25519 for backward compatibility.

key_id.description: Optional backend-scoped key identifier. Empty or absent for implicit local signatures.

backend.description: Optional signing backend label, such as local, https-http, aws-kms, gcp-kms, vault, or local:fallback:<backend>.

signed_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the signing operation.

atb.snapshot.description: Named bundle checkpoint appended by atb snapshot. Optional human oversight attribution fields support EU AI Act Article 14 evidence.

actor_id.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: identifier of the human approver or reviewer.

actor_role.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: role of the human approver or reviewer.

oversight_note.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: human rationale or review note captured with the snapshot.

atb.bundle.pushed.description: Marker appended by atb push after a bundle is replicated to a remote WORM target. Informational; not used for verification.

documented_event_types.$comment: Non-normative catalogue of event types emitted by the ATB Go runtime, CLI, and SDKs. The canonical type field remains an open dot-namespaced string (see properties.type); this block documents the shape readers and downstream tooling can expect for each known type. Property lists are illustrative, not exhaustive: writers may include additional fields (digests, source_role, source_line_num, request_id) that aid traceability without changing the canonical hash contract.

ai.request.received.description: AI request received at the application boundary. Emitted by the runtime and by atb import chatlog when mapping a user turn.

request_id.description: Stable identifier for the request, used to correlate downstream model and tool events.

actor_id_hash.description: Hashed actor identifier for privacy-preserving attribution.

purpose_tag.description: Purpose tag describing why the request was made.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the request input, in hex.

input_format.description: Format identifier for the request input, such as text or json.

ai.response.sent.description: AI response sent from the application boundary. Emitted alongside model output when a response is returned to the caller.

output_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the response output, in hex.

ai.llm.call.description: Canonical LLM lifecycle event used by integrations that prefer a single call-shaped record over the model_invoked and model_output pair.

ai.tool.exec.description: Tool execution lifecycle event. Emitted by the runtime, by gate integrations, and by atb import chatlog when mapping a tool turn.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called.

tool_args.description: Decoded tool arguments as a JSON value when available.

tool_args_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical tool arguments.

tool_output.description: Tool output content captured as text. Optional; readers should fall back to tool_output_digest when absent.

tool_output_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the tool output.

ai.chain.run.description: Chain or step lifecycle event used by orchestration integrations such as LangChain.

ai.policy.decision.description: Policy engine decision (allow or deny) over a candidate action or response. May carry policy_signature, policy_signer_pubkey, policy_doc_hash, and policy_doc_signature fields when the decision is signed.

ai.retrieval.executed.description: Retrieval step executed during a RAG pipeline.

ai.model.invoked.description: LLM invocation sent. Emitted by the runtime and by atb import chatlog when mapping an assistant turn that names a model.

model_id.description: Model identifier as reported by the provider.

model_provider.description: Provider that served the model invocation, such as anthropic, openai, or google.

model_parameters_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalised invocation parameters.

prompt_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalised prompt.

ai.model.output.description: LLM output received. Companion to ai.model.invoked.

ai.action.precommit.description: Pre-commit record for a gated privileged action. Written before the action is executed.

ai.action.executed.description: Privileged action executed through the action gate.

ai.action.committed.description: Privileged action committed to its downstream sink.

ai.human.approval.description: Human approval of an action or override.

ai.override.requested.description: Human override requested over a prior automated decision.

ai.job.scheduled.description: Background job scheduled for asynchronous execution.

ai.job.started.description: Background job started by a worker.

ai.job.step.description: Individual step recorded within a background job run.

ai.job.completed.description: Background job completed, successfully or otherwise.

data.export.precommit.description: Pre-commit record for a data export. Written before the export is executed.

data.export.executed.description: Data export executed to its downstream sink.

atb.corroboration.external.description: External corroboration record retrieved by an adapter from a third-party system.

atb.event.rag_index.description: PageIndex document tree build record. Carries an index_hash and node_count summarising the indexed corpus.

atb.event.rag_retrieval.description: PageIndex reasoning-based retrieval result. Carries node_id and page_start/page_end identifying the retrieved span.

dev.session.description: Developer session marker used by tooling and tests.

snapshot.build.description: Build snapshot marker used by tooling and tests.

seq.description: Sequence number of this event within the bundle. 0 is reserved for the bundle manifest record.

prev_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the previous event, or 64 zeros (genesis sentinel) for the first event.

type.description: Dot-namespaced event type identifier. Reserved system types include atb.bundle.manifest and atb.bundle.anchor.

hash_algo.description: Hash algorithm used to compute this event's hash.

actor_id.description: Optional actor identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

org_id.description: Optional organization identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of event creation. When present, included in the canonical hash.

parent_span_id.description: W3C trace context parent span identifier.
